description: Warm, friendly and very clear female narrator in her thirties, like a kind kindergarten teacher. Speaks General American English with precise pronunciation, slightly slow pace, calm and encouraging, smiling tone, for children aged 5 to 8.
ref_text: Hello! I am so glad you are here. Today we will count together: one, two, three. Can you hear the sound? M as in moon. You did a really great job!
